title: Which country will win the men's team gymnastics gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
background: The Commonwealth Games men's team gymnastics competition awards medals according to the final team standings.
resolution_criteria:

title: Which two countries will reach the final of the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations?
background: The Women's Africa Cup of Nations is Africa's continental championship for women's national football teams. The winners of its two semifinals advance to the final.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: CAF's official tournament results, supported where necessary by contemporaneous match reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve once both semifinals of the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations have concluded and the two finalists have been determined. The result of the final itself is not relevant.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The two finalist country names in alphabetical order, separated by a comma.
